title: The Short Sum
story: Chilaka wrote a function to add 1 up to n, and proudly says it works. It does not.
goal: Diagnose the bug, then fix the code so every check passes.
hints: Try total(3) by hand. Which numbers does range(1, 3) give?
The end of range is excluded.
socratic: What did you expect it to do?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?

parrot.says: Squawk! I add every number from 1 to n. Easy! (n = 3 gives me 3... is that right?)

diagnose.question: What is wrong?
options: The loop stops one number early, so n is never added
The variable total is spelled wrong
range cannot be used with sum
diagnose.why: range(1, n) stops BEFORE n. Use range(1, n + 1) so n is included.
